mozii.name: Mozii
mozii.tagline: Play your music files with style
mozii.description: A file-based music player with lyrics translation, animated lyrics, and endless customization — all wrapped in a clean, minimal design.

playback.title: Lyrics Translation & Animated Lyrics
playback.description: View translated lyrics in real time and enjoy beautifully animated lyrics that sync with your music.

library.title: Minimal Design
library.description: A clean, simple interface that stays out of your way and lets you focus on your music.

ui.title: Fully Customizable
ui.description: Personalize your experience with extensive settings — themes, layouts, playback behaviors, and more.

guide.step1: Add your music files to Mozii and start browsing your library.
guide.step2: Tap a track to play and enjoy animated lyrics with translation support.
guide.step3: Explore settings to customize the interface and playback to your liking.

mapMemory.name: Map Memory
mapMemory.description: Automatically records your location history, like a personal timeline of your life.

timeline.title: Location Timeline
timeline.description: View your past locations on an interactive timeline, similar to Google Maps Timeline.

map.title: Visual Map View
map.description: See all your visited places plotted on a beautiful, interactive map.

privacy.title: Privacy First
privacy.description: All data stays on your device. Your location history is yours alone.

guide.step1: Grant location permissions and let Map Memory start recording in the background.
guide.step2: Check your timeline anytime to see where you've been throughout the day.
guide.step3: Browse the map view to explore all the places you've visited over time.

gphones.name: GPhones
gphones.description: Measure your real-time speed using GPS and keep a detailed record of every trip.

speed.title: Real-time Speed
speed.description: Get accurate, GPS-based speed readings displayed in a clean, easy-to-read format.

tracking.title: Trip Recording
tracking.description: Record your entire journey with detailed speed data throughout the trip.

history.title: Speed History
history.description: Review past trips with speed graphs, max speed, average speed, and distance.

guide.step1: Open GPhones and grant GPS permissions for accurate speed readings.
guide.step2: Start a trip recording to capture your speed throughout the journey.
guide.step3: Review your trip history with detailed speed charts and statistics.

adguardDns.name: AGD Remote
adguardDns.tagline: Take control of your DNS filtering
adguardDns.description: A mobile dashboard for AdGuard DNS — manage your DNS settings, browse query logs, and configure filters, all from your iPhone.

dashboard.title: DNS Dashboard
dashboard.description: Monitor your DNS filtering status, view statistics, and toggle protection on or off in real time.

queryLog.title: Query Log
queryLog.description: Browse detailed DNS query logs to see which domains are being blocked or allowed.

filters.title: Custom Filters
filters.description: Configure blocklists, allowlists, and custom filtering rules to fine-tune your DNS protection.

guide.step1: Connect your AdGuard DNS account to start managing your DNS settings.
guide.step2: Browse the query log to see real-time DNS activity and blocked requests.
guide.step3: Customize your filters and rules to match your privacy preferences.

money.name: SaBee
money.description: A clean expense tracker with no developer-operated server. Your financial data stays on your device unless you choose iCloud sync or collaboration.

privacy.title: Private by Design
privacy.description: No account and no developer-operated server. Your records stay on your device, or in your iCloud account when you enable sync.

collaboration.title: Shared Ledgers
collaboration.description: Invite people to an iCloud shared ledger and keep household, travel, or group expenses up to date together.

tracking.title: Simple Tracking
tracking.description: Record income and expenses in a calm, minimal interface designed for everyday use.

guide.step1: Create a ledger, then add your income and expenses as they happen.
guide.step2: Enable iCloud sync if you want your records available across your Apple devices.
guide.step3: Share a ledger through iCloud when you want to track money together with other people.

wiregram.name: Wiregram
wiregram.tagline: A simpler way to read your feeds
wiregram.description: A minimal RSS reader for following the sources you care about. Translate articles and use Apple Intelligence to create summaries, outline key points, and ask questions about what you read.

reading.title: Focused Reading
reading.description: Follow your RSS feeds and enjoy articles in a clean, minimal interface that keeps the focus on reading.

translation.title: Article Translation
translation.description: Translate articles to explore perspectives and stories in other languages.

intelligence.title: Apple Intelligence
intelligence.description: Create summaries, organize key points into outlines, and ask questions about articles with Apple Intelligence.

guide.step1: Add the RSS feeds you want to follow to Wiregram.
guide.step2: Open an article to read it, and translate it when you need to.
guide.step3: Use Apple Intelligence to summarize an article, create an outline, or ask questions about its content.

wiregram.intelligenceAvailability: Apple Intelligence features require a supported device with Apple Intelligence enabled. Availability varies by language and region.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Your privacy matters. Every app I build is designed with your privacy in mind. I do not collect or store personal data without your consent.

dataCollection.title: Data Collection
dataCollection.body: I do not intentionally collect personal information. Your app data lives on your device and is not sent to any server I operate.

inAppPurchases.title: In-App Purchases
inAppPurchases.body: In-app purchases are processed through Apple. I may verify your purchase status via Apple's receipt validation, but I do not have access to your payment details.

thirdParty.title: Device, iCloud & Third-Party Services
thirdParty.body: I do not operate backend servers that collect app data. Your data stays on your device by default. If you enable iCloud sync or sharing, relevant data is stored and transmitted through Apple iCloud, and people you invite can access shared records. Some apps connect to third-party services only when you choose and configure them.

wiregram.title: Wiregram
wiregram.body: Wiregram retrieves RSS feeds and article content from the sources you choose. Translation and AI features use Apple system capabilities. I do not operate a backend for Wiregram or use analytics or tracking in the app.

analytics.title: Analytics & Tracking
analytics.body: As of this writing, I do not use any analytics, tracking, or advertising frameworks in my apps.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: I do not proactively contact users. If you have questions about this privacy policy, you can reach me through the feedback feature on this website.
